Listings.explanation: Nearby search runs ST_DWithin and ST_Distance against pickup_location, always with deleted_at IS NULL. When the client does not pass a radius, SEARCH_RADIUS_KM is read from the system config - which is why ListingsService keeps a reference to SystemConfigService. Providers upload images first, then create the listing with the returned URLs. Only verified providers can publish, and pickup_location is constructed from the supplied coordinates with ST_MakePoint so the listing is discoverable. Edit, publish, cancel, soft-delete and duplicate. A listing with active orders cannot be deleted; cancelling a listing notifies all receivers who are still holding an order. Delete is soft: deleted_at is set and every query filters on it.
